concerns.text: T059, T060, T061, T062, and T063 are all tagged with `[US1/US2/US3]` indicating parallel execution. However, the 'CPU Feasibility & Resource Hardening' phase description states this is a *strict prerequisite* for ALL user story execution tasks. This implies sequential dependency, contradicting the [P] tag. Clarify whether these tasks can truly run in parallel or if they must be completed sequentially before any US1/US2/US3 task begins.

T018b depends on T018c, and T018c depends on T018d-impl. However, the order of these tasks within Phase 4 is not explicitly defined. Ensure a clear dependency chain (e.g., T018c *after* T018b, T018d-impl after T018c) to prevent potential errors.

The task list for Phase 6 (User Story 3) includes several dependencies on the completion of tasks from earlier phases (e.g., T040 depends on T018c, T040b depends on T018d-verify). While these are logical, explicitly stating this dependency in each task description would improve clarity and prevent potential confusion.

T067's description mentions 'duplicate ID conflict from Phase 7 (formerly T061)'. This is unclear without context. Briefly explain the origin of this conflict or provide a link to relevant documentation.
